findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on ".hud-pill" for opacity, scale between 0.10s and 0.50s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on ".scene-headline" for opacity, y between 0.20s and 0.70s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target ".scene-bg" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
